title: PTA Issues 59 Cybersecurity Advisories to Telecoms
excerpt: The Pakistan Telecommunication Authority sent multiple cybersecurity warnings to telecom licensees between July 2025 and June 2026.
body_html:
The Pakistan Telecommunication Authority (PTA) has issued a total of 59 cybersecurity advisories to telecom licensees.

These warnings were distributed over a period ranging from July 2025 to June 2026, highlighting various security concerns for the telecommunications sector in the country.
